# stripe_billing_feedback_option (Data Source)

A reason a customer can pick when canceling a subscription. `terraform destroy` deactivates the option, because Stripe cannot delete one; it stays in the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_billing_feedback_option" "too_expensive" {
  id = stripe_billing_feedback_option.too_expensive.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the object.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The text of the feedback option, which customers see when canceling. Maximum 100 characters.
- `livemode` (Boolean) If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
- `status` (String) The feedback option's status. Possible values: `active`, `inactive`.
- `status_transitions` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_transitions))

<a id="nestedatt--status_transitions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status_transitions`

Read-Only:

- `deactivated_at` (Number) The time the feedback option was deactivated, if any. Measured in seconds since Unix epoch.
